task: fit coherent dependence while preserving0.5 predicted marginal distributions
learned_parameters: one dependence exponent gamma; both neural networks frozen, no neural retraining
fit_origins: 2048 deterministic evenly spaced fit origins only; conditional target labels used only in joint loss
selection: lowest development joint log loss among three declared variants, fixed order breaks ties
matrix_scaling: positive kernel max(T,1e-30)^gamma; predicted row/column constraints; relative tolerance1e-8,max2000; failure stops run
invariant: normalized chain forward marginal differs from0.5 targets by at most2e-7 absolute probability
calibration: no new temperature fit; use frozen parents including their prior calibration; calibration partition is descriptive, not independent
data_flow: parents used fit/development/calibration previously; scalar fit uses their frozen outputs. No pure-crossfit or fresh calibration claim.
limitations: Scalar coupling cannot improve direction because marginals are preserved.
Finite price bins, unknown within-bin state and hidden/future orders.
